description: Implementation of BankingService interface providing core banking operations such as customer management, account handling, fund transfers, and transaction retrieval in a Spring-based Java application.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing core banking operations, including customer management, account processing, and transactions, with database interaction via repositories.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers with their details

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates and saves a new customer record

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by customer number

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record by customer number

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds an account by account number

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account linked to a customer

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Transfers funds between accounts for a customer, recording transactions

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions associated with an account
